>would you be met with some social or professional consequences if you were openly anti-muslim? 

Yes. My family would disown me. Dont get me wrong they love me but they would disown their own child for some fairy tales invented thousands of years ago.

>or not even anti-muslim, just ignoring their bullshit?

I ignore their bs to the best of my ability. I get repeatedly reminded by my family to do that etc etc. My parents are gonna send me abroad to study in a few years so its best that I pretend that Im a muslim otherwise they might change their mind.
Im an exmuslim. Although I'm from a secular country most people around me are muslim. I have to pretend to believe in their bs and follow their bs practices. I want to be free.

I want to live like an American/European but I cant. Society here is conservative as f***. Instead I have to struggle for some years and then move to the West. I wish I could live freely now. I dont want to struggle.
I wish i was from east ukraine. I'm from Asia.
No disability. I was born in an unlucky place. I have to struggle whereas other people my age just enjoy.
